description: This PHP source file defines the RouteSubscriber class for Drupal views module, responsible for managing route collection and alteration for views based on display IDs and view storage.

classes.name: Drupal\views\EventSubscriber\RouteSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to routing events to build and alter routes for views in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the RouteSubscriber with entity type manager and state services.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the route subscriber.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, including route rebuild finished and route alteration.

methods.name: getViewsDisplayIDsWithRoute
methods.description: Retrieves all view and display ID pairs that have associated routes.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Generates and returns a collection of routes based on views and displays.

methods.name: alterRoutes
methods.description: Alters existing routes based on views and display configurations.

methods.name: routeRebuildFinished
methods.description: Callback to reset state and save view route names after route rebuild.

methods.name: getApplicableViews
methods.description: Returns views that are applicable for route generation.
